ModMetaData.name: MA - VRE Highmate Render Fix 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ShangRuo
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 compatibility hotfix for Melee Animation and Vanilla Races Expanded - Highmate. Guards the Highmate HeadgearVisible postfix against incomplete PawnDrawParms used by temporary Melee Animation render passes, and suppresses only NullReferenceException thrown by that specific Highmate postfix while inside Melee Animation DrawPawns. Other render exceptions remain visible.
